scope.description: Whole meshio application/library breadth across useful functional families.
scope.denominator: Mesh format interchange, mixed/high-order cell topology, point/cell data and sets, time-series and format-specific metadata.

coverage.rationale: Hexahedral CAE volumes strengthen static interchange, but only two ASCII formats and a small topology/data subset are authorable; groups/sets, solver formats and temporal families remain absent. Breadth remains 10%.

scope.description: Strict ASCII linear triangle/tetra/eight-node-hexahedron VTU and legacy VTK volume interchange with explicit units and exact ordered topology/field preservation.
scope.denominator: User intent and domain decisions within the named supported workflows, including declared inputs, composition and useful outputs; excluded application features do not enter this score.

abstraction.rationale: Explicit units, strict preservation, independently integrated volumes and useful verified handoffs remove procedural reader/writer code; users still manage format selection, field units and mesh-quality assessment. Abstraction remains 60%.

limitations: ASCII linear triangle/tetra/eight-node-hex subset only; Jacobian sampling is not global validity proof. No compressed/binary data, broad solver formats, groups/sets, high-order or unsupported metadata.
Editorial planning estimate; bounded native acceptance covers literal affine/warped fixtures and named controls, not an exhaustive native API denominator. Query qualification/runtime separately.
